summary: Essential Properties, L.P. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a public offering of $400M aggregate principal amount of 5.375% Senior Notes due 2036, guaranteed by its parent Essential Properties Realty Trust, Inc. The notes were priced at 98.119% of par, with underwriting discount of 0.650% and net proceeds of ~$389.9M. Interest is payable semi-annually, and the notes are redeemable at par after April 15, 2036. There is no intent to list the notes on any exchange. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation.
